shorts.title: Florida Issues Arrest Warrant For Raúl Castro Over 1996 Shootdown #Shorts
shorts.hook: Florida Judge Signs Raúl Castro Warrant
shorts.narration: [serious] Friends, a Florida judge has signed an arrest warrant for Raúl Castro. It concerns the February 1996 shootdown of two unarmed Brothers to the Rescue planes over international waters. Four men were killed. Chief Judge Ariana Fajardo Orshan found probable cause that Castro conspired to commit first-degree murder. He was Cuba's defense minister at the time. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier said Castro allegedly ordered a "premeditated, state-sanctioned murder of four Floridians in cold blood." [beat] [deadpan] The attorney general's office says the warrant could limit where Castro can travel. Frequent flier miles just got a lot less useful. Congressman Carlos Giménez, the only Cuban-born member of Congress, called it historic. Genesis 4:10: "The voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground." [beat] To anyone still romanticizing Havana's regime: explain this one in the comments. Subscribe for the daily news.

shorts.title: Trump Voters On Pricey Gas And Iran: "I'll Take That Any Day" #Shorts
shorts.hook: Trump Voter: "I'll Take That Any Day"
shorts.narration: [warm] Folks, at Trump's rally in Greenville, North Carolina, Fox News asked supporters about painful gas prices. One voter named Michael answered, quote, "I'll take that any day to stop a country like Iran and take that nuclear power away." [beat] [deadpan] Notice he did not say "Biden did it." [serious] Not everyone is cheery. A man named Steve said, quote, "It would take an act of God to lower prices before this election is over." Trump has called the Iran war a, quote, "small price to pay" for keeping the nation safe. [beat] [amused] Democrats see a campaign ad at the pump. These voters see a nuclear Iran and say no thanks. Luke 14:28: "For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost." So Democrats, would you pay it? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe, Henry roasts the news every day.
